properties.source: Hand-built from the campaign literature's own ward map (street-boundary labels) plus OpenStreetMap/Nominatim geocoding of two real anchor points (8850 McLaughlin Rd S; Steeles Ave W & Mavis Rd). Brampton GeoHub's published 'Ward Boundaries' dataset could not be pulled programmatically (its dataset page is JS-rendered/ArcGIS Hub and its listed data is dated Dec 1, 2014, predating recent ward boundary reviews), and OpenStreetMap Nominatim does not support precise street-intersection geocoding. This polygon is therefore a best-effort approximation, not survey-grade data.
properties.verification_needed: Before treating the ward lookup tool as authoritative, cross-check/replace these coordinates against the City of Brampton's current official Wards 3 & 4 boundary (e.g. via GeoHub's interactive map export or a GIS tool), confirmed current for the 2026 election.
